summary.text: Shane Abbott represents District 5 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2022, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Abbott as a pharmacist and business owner from DeFuniak Springs who was born in West Palm Beach.
Abbott studied at Pensacola State College and received a B.S. in pharmacy from the University of Florida in 1998.

sources.title: Shane G. Abbott's official House profile
